text:
maria: Quick sync — onboarding sage-mini-v3 weights in s3://redwood-weights/sage-mini-v3/ landed but tokenizer is misbehaving in chat template. Anyone seeing extra <|bos|> tokens when calling encode(chat_history)?
song: Yep saw this locally, only when system prompt includes the sentinel. Might be double-inserting because we add BOS at runtime + template already has one.
aj: Repro steps? I can take a look.
maria: repro:
```
system = "<|bos|>You are an assistant.
User: {user}
Assistant:"
chat_history = [ ("user","hi") ]
encoded = tok.encode(system + chat_history)
# encoded shows BOS token twice at start
```
aj: ah ok. That template definitely has the sentinel baked in. Our serving runtime used to strip leading sentinels before batching, but recent tokenizer swap changed behavior.
dev-bot: Tokenizer mapping check ran on PR 482: token-id-delta=+1 for <|bos|>, unexpectedly.
ci-bot: CI failure: tokenizer-mapping check (jobs/tokenizer-compat) — see https://ci.redwood.ai/job/482 for logs.
song: Workaround: remove explicit <|bos|> from system template and let runtime add it. But that's a risky wide change for existing templates.
oliver: We should enforce a config validation on model manifests: warn if template contains special tokens that runtime will add. PR idea: manifest schema add field `template_contains_sentinels: true|false` and validator.
aj: I pushed a tiny patch branch: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/tokenizer-fixes/branch/bos-eos-compat. It normalizes special token mapping and adds a unit test.
maria: Where are the weights referenced in the manifest pointing to? I want to confirm we didn't onboard a stale tokenizer.
aj: manifest points to s3://redwood-weights/sage-mini-v3/{weights.bin,tokenizer.json} (version 2026-03-10).
song: Tokenizer.json shows bos_token: "<|bos|>", bos_token_id: 1, eos_token_id: 2. Runtime expects bos_id==0 historically. mismatch is the root cause.
oliver: Proposed quickpatch: runtime accepts nonzero bos_id BUT strips any template-level sentinel if manifest.meta.template_claims_bos == true. Also add linter that fails CI if token ids shift from verified profile.
maria: Sounds good. Can someone open a small ops ticket and patch CI? I don't want prod rollouts until we have the validator.
aj: Opening ticket TKT-324, assigning to infra + eng-ml, linking PR.
maria: Also pinging @oliver for code review once the PR is up.
oliver: I'll review. If tests pass, we can canary to staging tonight.
song: FYI, quick local hack to repro (python):
```python
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.load('s3://redwood-weights/sage-mini-v3/tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode('<|bos|>hi'))
print(t.encode('hi', add_bos=True))
```
# shows duplicate id at start in first case

maria: ok assigned, moving to async. I'll update thread when TKT-324 has PR link. Thanks all :thumbsup:
